editorial.titleTr: Criminal Procedure Law Finally Approved by Cabinet Meeting...Patchwork Fixes Over Flawed Framework
summaryTr: Criminal Procedure Act amendments abolish prosecutors' investigative authority and concentrate power with police.

editorial.titleTr: Column: Are Elderly Forced to Relocate for the 'Crime' of Long-Term Residency?
summaryTr: The government's real estate tax reform is imposing excessive tax burdens on elderly homeowners who have owned their properties for a long time.
The reduction of long-term holding deductions is threatening the housing rights of single-home owners.
Critics point out that tax incentives for relocating to provincial areas amount to coercing elderly residents to move.
editorial.bodyTr: The government's real estate tax reform plan has drawn criticism for imposing excessive acquisition and transfer taxes on elderly homeowners who have lived in their primary residences for extended periods. In particular, the reduction in long-term holding deductions is threatening the residential rights of actual residents, and policies offering tax benefits for relocating to provincial areas are being flagged for effectively coercing elderly residents to move against their will.

editorials.titleTr: [Editorial] Was the Dec. 3 Martial Law a Military Academy Coup? Just a Scapegoat Following Orders
summaryTr: It is unfair to characterize the December 3rd martial law as a military academy coup in the context of this president's policy to dismantle the military academy.
Those involved in the martial law were merely scapegoats following the chain of command, not the masterminds.
A hasty consolidation for political purposes is a dangerous act that threatens the future of the military.
editorials.bodyTr: In a situation where President Lee Jae-myung has clarified that the essence of military academy integration is the dismantling of the Korea Military Academy, it is unjust to characterize the December 3 martial law as a military academy coup. This editorial argues that those involved in the martial law are merely sacrificial lambs of the chain of command, and that using this as grounds to stigmatize the entire military academy and push forward with hastily orchestrated integration for political purposes constitutes an act that threatens the future of the military.

editorials.titleTr: [Editorial] Is Starbucks Belated Search a Thank You for Prosecution's Loss of Investigative Powers?
summaryTr: Police conducted a search and seizure of Starbucks headquarters for the first time in 76 days.
The investigation into allegations of insulting the May 18 uprising proceeded despite unclear corporate intent.
Controversy has been raised over targeted investigations that appear to cater to the administration's interests.
editorials.bodyTr: The Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency's Broad Investigation Division conducted a search and seizure of Starbucks headquarters over allegations that the company insulted those honored for their contributions to the May 18 Democratic Uprising. Coming 76 days after the incident occurred, the forced investigation is being criticized as an excessive response conducted despite unclear corporate intent, and as a targeted investigation reflecting the government's political interests.

editorial.body: 입력 이재명 대통령이 어제 국방부 업무보고에서 “지금까지 대한민국의 군사 쿠데타가 몇 번 있었나. 다 육군에서 벌어진 일 아닌가”라고 지적했다. 그러면서 “군별로 따로 떼어서 군을 육성하고, 아주 장기간 특정 군종이 군대를 압도적으로 장악하고, 가끔 쿠데타를 일으켜 나라를 절단내고 난 다음 아무런 책임을 안 지면 되겠나”라며 “(3군 사관학교를) 통합하면 이런 가능성이 좀 줄어들지 않겠나”라고 말했다. 멀게는 5·16과 12·12, 가까이는 2024년의 12·3 비상계엄을 지목하면서 이런 일을 예방하기 위해 특정 군종, 즉 육군의 장악력을 약화시키고 그 일환으로 3군 사관학교를 통합해야 한다는 인식을 밝힌 것이다. 현재 커다란 논란이 되고 있는 사관학교 통합 추진의 진짜 배경이 육사 벌주기, 나아가 육군 힘빼기에 있다는 의혹이 결코 억측이 아니었음을 입증하는 발언이라 해도 과언이 아니다. 대통령의 발언은 그동안 국방부가 육·해·공군 간 벽을 허물고 융합형 인재를 양성하는 합동성 강화를 위해 사관학교 통합을 추진한다고 밝혀온 것과는 전혀 결이 다르다. 사관학교를 통합하면 쿠데타 가능성이 줄어들 것이라는 주장은 현실과 동떨어져 있다. 3군 사관학교 통합 교육을 하고 있는 몇 안 되는 국가인 태국이 주요 국가 가운데 쿠데타가 가장 빈발하는 나라인 사실만 봐도 그렇다. 태국은 생도 시절부터 형성된 기수별 인맥과 강력한 유대감이 오히려 군부 결속의 고리로 작용해 수시로 쿠데타가 발생하는 나라라는 오명을 쓰고 있다. 사관학교 통합이 쿠데타 방지의 만병통치약이 될 수 없다는 방증이다. 정치적 앙금과 징벌적 명분이 앞서다 보니 통합안 자체가 오락가락하며 대전 자운대에 ‘바다 없는 해사’ ‘활주로 없는 공사’라는 기형적 형태의 국군사관학교 안까지 나왔다. 군사 쿠데타는 다시는 일어나선 안 된다. 정치적 목적의 비상계엄도 마찬가지다. 군의 엄정한 정치적 중립과 헌정 수호 의지는 아무리 강조해도 지나치지 않다. 그러나 과거 역사와 결부된 정치적 관점에 바탕을 두고 안보의 백년대계라 할 수 있는 군 엘리트 교육 체계를 근본부터 흔드는 것은 타당하지 않다. 군 개혁의 유일한 목표는 강군 육성과 국가 안보에 있을 뿐이다.

국방부의 합동성 강화 명분과 달리 육군 약화가 진짜 목표라는 의혹을 드러냈다.

editorial.titleTr: COMMENTARY: Is Merging Military Academies Really About Punishing the Army?
summaryTr: This president cited the Army's coup d'état history as the reason for integrating military academies.
It revealed suspicions that the real goal is weakening the Army, contrary to the Defense Ministry's justification of strengthening joint operations.
He criticizes the political agenda, arguing that integrating military academies cannot be an effective measure to prevent coups.
editorial.bodyTr: President Lee Jae-myung pointed out yesterday during a Defense Ministry briefing that "How many military coups have there been in South Korea so far? Haven't they all taken place within the Army?" He went on to say, "If we separate each branch and cultivate them individually, and allow a specific branch to overwhelmingly dominate the military for extended periods, occasionally launch coups, tear the nation apart, and then face no accountability, how can that be right?" Adding that merging the three service academies might reduce such possibilities, he indicated a recognition that preventing such incidents requires weakening the control of a particular branch—namely the Army—and that integrating the three service academies is part of that effort. His remarks, pointing to 5·16 and 12·12 in the distant past and the 12·3 emergency martial law of 2024 more recently, represent little exaggeration in proving that suspicions about the true motivation behind the military academy merger push being about punishing the Army Academy and ultimately weakening the Army were never mere speculation. The president's remarks stand in stark contrast to what the Defense Ministry has previously stated—that it is pushing for military academy integration to strengthen joint operations and foster convergent talent by breaking down barriers between the Army, Navy, and Air Force. The claim that merging service academies would reduce coup possibilities is disconnected from reality. This is evident from the fact that Thailand, one of the few major nations with integrated tri-service academy education, is among developed countries most prone to military coups. Thailand has earned the unfortunate distinction of being a nation where strong class-based connections and solidarity formed during cadet years actually serve as bonds that reinforce military cohesion, leading to frequent coups. This is evidence that military academy integration cannot be a cure-all for preventing coups. As political grievances and punitive justifications take precedence, even the integration plan itself has become inconsistent, resulting in the bizarre form of a National Defense University in Daejeon with a "navy without a sea" and "air force without a runway." Military coups must never happen again. The same applies to emergency martial law for political purposes. The military's strict political neutrality and commitment to constitutional governance cannot be overemphasized. However, it is inappropriate to fundamentally shake the military elite education system—which can be called a centennial project for national security—based on political perspectives tied to past history. The sole objective of military reform must be the cultivation of a strong military and national security.

leanScore.rationale: 대통령의 군개혁 정책을 '정치적 목적', '징벌적 명분', '육군 벌주기'로 비판하며 안보와 군 엘리트 교육 체계 보호를 우선시하는 보수적 입장을 명확히 함.

editorial.title: Wrong prescription
editorial.body: Government's tax overhaul punishes owners of high-priced single homes The Lee Jae Myung administration said it would gather a wide range of market views through five rounds of public debates on real estate policy. Yet the tax reform package the government unveiled on Monday following the debates ultimately amounted to a tax hike. Lee's pledge not to use taxation as a tool of housing policy has vanished into thin air. The government announced a package that would sharply raise both the holding tax (the Comprehensive Real Estate Tax) and the transaction tax (the capital gains tax) even on owners of a single home if they do not live in the property or if the home is worth more than a specified amount. Previous Democratic Party of Korea governments, including those of Presidents Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in, were criticized for fueling the trend toward owning a single high-value home by imposing heavier taxes on owners of multiple homes. Yet the Lee administration has made even that single home subject to punitive taxation. The government has not previously treated single-home owners as real estate speculators. Yet its abrupt policy reversal to impose punitive tax hikes even on them could create numerous innocent victims. Above all, if the government intends to raise holding taxes, it should overhaul the entire tax rate structure. Effectively targeting only single-home owners in certain socioeconomic groups or regions runs counter to the principle of tax fairness. This is why critics accuse the government of pursuing a tax hike based on an "us-versus-them" division among taxpayers in an attempt to cover up its failure in real estate policy. The surge in housing prices is the result of the government's policy failures and inflation, yet the Lee administration is holding owners of high-priced homes responsible. The government is also making it harder for people to buy and sell their homes. A basic market principle is to sharply lower capital gains tax, a transaction tax, when holding taxes are increased. Yet the government ignored this principle and scaled back the capital gains tax deduction system. In Korea, single-home owners are eligible for a capital gains tax deduction when they sell their homes after holding them or living in them for an extended period. This system was introduced to reduce the excessive capital gains tax burden faced by long-term homeowners when selling their homes, as inflation has increased their capital gains. That way, homeowners can sell their homes more easily and move with a lower tax burden. However, those who have held their homes for decades in reliance on this system now face massive capital gains tax bills as a result of reduced deductions. After selling their homes and paying huge capital gains taxes, homeowners would find it virtually impossible to move to a similar living environment or a more desirable area. The government claims that the two-year transition period included in the plan to reduce capital gains tax deduction provides homeowners with a window to sell their properties. However, even when homeowners put their properties up for sale, expanded land transaction permit zones and tighter lending regulations are dampening transactions. Additionally, it is doubtful how many people can realistically afford to buy Seoul's ultraexpensive apartments — about 4.5 billion won ($3.2 million) or more at market price — the primary target of this tax hike package. One cannot help but ask whether it is reasonable for a tax policy to force retirees who cannot afford to pay the taxes out of the single homes they have lived in all their lives. Tax hikes are more likely to distort the market than stabilize home prices, as the prior experience of the Roh and Moon administrations has shown. Trying to suppress demand through higher taxes while failing to supply enough homes in areas where people want to live will only exacerbate housing price instability. 이재명 정부는 부동산 정책을 두고 5차례의 공개 토론회를 통해 광범위한 시장 의견을 수렴하겠다고 했다. 하지만 토론회 이후 정부가 월요일에 발표한 세제 개편안은 결국 증세에 불과했다. 세금을 주택정책의 수단으로 삼지 않겠다던 이 대통령의 공약은 물거품이 되었다. 정부는 자주택에 거주하지 않거나 주택 가격이 일정 수준 이상이면 보유세(종합부동산세)와 양도세(자본이득세) 모두를 대폭 인상하는 방안을 발표했다. 노무현 전 대통령과 문재인 전 대통령 등 과거 더불어민주당 정부들은 다주택 소유자에게 무거운 세금을 부과하면서 고가 단독주택 소유 추세를 부채질했다는 비판을 받아왔다. 그런데 이재명 정부는 단독주택까지 징벌적 세제의 대상으로 삼았다. 정부는 그간 단독주택 소유자를 부동산 투기꾼으로 취급한 적이 없었다. 그런데 갑자기 정책을 뒤바꿔 단독주택 소유자까지 징벌적 증세를 단행하려는 것은 무고한 피해자를 수없이 양산할 수 있다. 무엇보다 정부가 보유세를 인상하려 한다면 전체 세율 체계를 개편해야 한다. 특정 사회계층이나 지역의 단독주택 소유자만을 사실상 겨냥하는 것은 조세공평성 원칙에 어긋난다. 이것이 비판 세력이 정부가 납세자들 간의 '우리 대 그들' 분할을 바탕으로 부동산정책의 실패를 덮으려는 증세를 추진하고 있다고 지적하는 이유다. 주택 가격 급등은 정부의 정책 실패와 인플레이션의 결과인데도, 이재명 정부는 고가주택 소유자들에게 책임을 지우고 있다. 정부는 또한 주택 매매를 어렵게 만들고 있다. 기본적인 시장 원칙은 보유세를 인상할 때 거래세인 양도세는 대폭 낮추는 것이다. 그런데 정부는 이 원칙을 무시하고 양도세 감면제도를 축소했다. 한국에서 단독주택 소유자는 일정 기간 거주하거나 보유한 뒤 주택을 팔 때 양도세 감면을 받을 수 있다. 이 제도는 인플레이션으로 인해 늘어난 양도차익으로 인한 과도한 양도세 부담을 줄여주기 위해 도입됐다. 이를 통해 주택소유자들은 낮은 세 부담으로 주택을 더 쉽게 팔고 이사를 갈 수 있었다. 하지만 이 제도에 의존해 수십 년간 주택을 보유해온 사람들은 감면 축소로 인해 막대한 양도세 청구서를 받게 됐다. 주택을 팔아 거액의 양도세를 낸 뒤, 주택소유자들은 비슷한 생활환경이나 더 나은 지역으로 이사 가는 것이 거의 불가능해질 것이다. 정부는 양도세 감면을 축소하는 과정에 포함된 2년의 유예 기간이 주택소유자들에게 부동산을 팔 수 있는 기회의 창을 제공한다고 주장한다. 하지만 주택소유자들이 부동산을 시장에 내놓더라도, 확대된 토지거래허가구역과 강화된 대출 규제가 거래를 억제하고 있다. 게다가 이번 증세안의 주요 표적인 서울의 초고가 아파트(시장가 약 45억 원 이상)를 실제로 구입할 수 있는 사람이 과연 얼마나 될지 의문의 여지가 있다. 평생 거주해온 단독주택에서 세금을 낼 여력이 없는 퇴직자들을 강제로 내보내는 세제 정책이 합리적인지 묻지 않을 수 없다. 노무현 정부와 문재인 정부의 선례가 보여주듯이 증세는 주택 가격을 안정화하기보다는 시장을 왜곡할 가능성이 더 크다. 사람들이 살고 싶어 하는 지역에 충분한 주택을 공급하지 못하면서 높은 세금으로 수요를 억제하려는 시도는 주택 가격 불안정을 더욱 심화시킬 뿐이다.

editorials.title: Wrong prescription
editorials.body: Government's tax overhaul punishes owners of high-priced single homes The Lee Jae Myung administration said it would gather a wide range of market views through five rounds of public debates on real estate policy. Yet the tax reform package the government unveiled on Monday following the debates ultimately amounted to a tax hike. Lee's pledge not to use taxation as a tool of housing policy has vanished into thin air. The government announced a package that would sharply raise both the holding tax (the Comprehensive Real Estate Tax) and the transaction tax (the capital gains tax) even on owners of a single home if they do not live in the property or if the home is worth more than a specified amount. Previous Democratic Party of Korea governments, including those of Presidents Roh Moo-hyun and Moon Jae-in, were criticized for fueling the trend toward owning a single high-value home by imposing heavier taxes on owners of multiple homes. Yet the Lee administration has made even that single home subject to punitive taxation. The government has not previously treated single-home owners as real estate speculators. Yet its abrupt policy reversal to impose punitive tax hikes even on them could create numerous innocent victims. Above all, if the government intends to raise holding taxes, it should overhaul the entire tax rate structure. Effectively targeting only single-home owners in certain socioeconomic groups or regions runs counter to the principle of tax fairness. This is why critics accuse the government of pursuing a tax hike based on an "us-versus-them" division among taxpayers in an attempt to cover up its failure in real estate policy. The surge in housing prices is the result of the government's policy failures and inflation, yet the Lee administration is holding owners of high-priced homes responsible. The government is also making it harder for people to buy and sell their homes. A basic market principle is to sharply lower capital gains tax, a transaction tax, when holding taxes are increased. Yet the government ignored this principle and scaled back the capital gains tax deduction system. In Korea, single-home owners are eligible for a capital gains tax deduction when they sell their homes after holding them or living in them for an extended period. This system was introduced to reduce the excessive capital gains tax burden faced by long-term homeowners when selling their homes, as inflation has increased their capital gains. That way, homeowners can sell their homes more easily and move with a lower tax burden. However, those who have held their homes for decades in reliance on this system now face massive capital gains tax bills as a result of reduced deductions. After selling their homes and paying huge capital gains taxes, homeowners would find it virtually impossible to move to a similar living environment or a more desirable area. The government claims that the two-year transition period included in the plan to reduce capital gains tax deduction provides homeowners with a window to sell their properties. However, even when homeowners put their properties up for sale, expanded land transaction permit zones and tighter lending regulations are dampening transactions. Additionally, it is doubtful how many people can realistically afford to buy Seoul's ultraexpensive apartments — about 4.5 billion won ($3.2 million) or more at market price — the primary target of this tax hike package. One cannot help but ask whether it is reasonable for a tax policy to force retirees who cannot afford to pay the taxes out of the single homes they have lived in all their lives. Tax hikes are more likely to distort the market than stabilize home prices, as the prior experience of the Roh and Moon administrations has shown. Trying to suppress demand through higher taxes while failing to supply enough homes in areas where people want to live will only exacerbate housing price instability. Aims to address AI era and ease excessive competition
Careful review and social deliberation needed
editorial.bodyTr: The Presidential National Education Committee reported on the 5th that it is reviewing a mid- to long-term plan to overhaul the university entrance system, which would introduce essay and argumentative questions as well as absolute evaluation into the College Entrance Examination. Given the need for educational innovation to respond to the age of artificial intelligence and ease competition, we view this as a step in the right direction.
